items.html: And after all these sortings that were sorted at the time of the creation of the worlds ABYA, that which was not sorted then, because of the abundance of dross still in them — since the good departs and only a small measure of good remains together with all the evil, and each day the good departs and is sorted and the evil remains — therefore those parts that were not sorted before the generations of Adam HaRishon, and needed to be sorted through the MAN that man would raise by his deeds, they were the dross and the shells. And they too were in the aforementioned manner of ABYA: for from the finest part of them came into being the dross of the Atzilut of the shells, and this too according to its degrees, Atik and Arich, etc.; and the worse, in the Beria of the dross, and this too in the manner of its degrees, etc., in this way down to Assiya.
